messages:
Maya: Heads up — planning a 15-min 'room jams' segment for our virtual retreat next Friday. Need 3 short playlists (~30 min each) for different vibes: 'focus', 'celebrate', 'chillout'. Throw recs or links? :headphones:
jamie: Love it. For 'celebrate' — toss in Lizzo 'Good as Hell', MGMT 'Electric Feel', Florence 'Dog Days Are Over'. Quick share: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/celebrate-xyz :confetti_ball:
ben: Chillout recs: Bonobo, Khruangbin, The Cinematic Orchestra. Also 'Rainy Day' by Emancipator. I'll DM a mellow playlist. :coffee:
rachel: Focus vibe = lo-fi + minimalist piano. 'Weightless' by Marconi Union works if we want ultra-calming. Short one-track loop works for 15 min rooms.
sofia: Also thinking a 90s alt mini-mix for one room — Pixies, Weezer, Belly. Quick poll: do people want 'newer hits' or 'nostalgia' for the third room? :nerd_face:
Maya: Poll time — reply with A for newer hits, B for nostalgia
jamie: A
ben: B
rachel: B
sofia: A
Maya: Looks tied at the moment. Ok — tiny extra ask: can people drop a one-sentence icebreaker prompt to put into each room? I'll compile them into the room cards.
jamie: 'What's the most embarrassing song on your playlist right now?' :joy:
ben: 'Name a show you binged recently and why it was impossible to stop.'
rachel: 'First concert you ever went to and one memory from it.'
sofia: 'Guilty pleasure snack for the snack break.' :cookie:
Maya: love these. Also thinking of a 3-track 'ambient transition' for when we move between rooms — suggestions?
ben: 'Nujabes — Feather', 'Tycho — A Walk', 'Boards of Canada — Roygbiv'
jamie: 'Ólafur Arnalds — Near Light' fits too
ops-bot: Reminder: virtual-retreat-playlists upload deadline in 48 hours. (automated) :robot_face:
Maya: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll assemble the playlists + room assignments and drop a single pack in #random by tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
